svg.text: HERON clock board rev C: signal-flow circuit diagram
Source: rev C netlist (heron_clock.net). Reference designators match the KiCad board. Ground symbols are all one GND net.
A. POWER INPUT (5 V from payload rail)
J1 pin 1 = +5 V, pin 2 = GND. D2 blocks reverse polarity. FB1 filters the rail.
VIN_5V decoupling: C1 10 µF, C2 100 nF (at FB1); C3, C5 1 µF (at each LDO). Test point TP1.
Buffers. Out: C6 2.2 µF, C7 10 µF
OE (pin 1) = OSC_OE, R2 10 kΩ pull-up = on
NC pins = GND (SiTime layout rule). TP5 on OSC_OE.
D. 10 MHz OUTPUTS x4: DC block, 5th-order low-pass (fc about 13 MHz, 50 Ω), 3 dB pad, ESD, SMP jack
Level at a 50 Ω load: about +7 dBm (1.4 Vpp). C13/C15 = 270 pF, C14 = 470 pF, L = 820 nH (Chebyshev 0.1 dB). R7, R6, R8 make a 3 dB pi pad.
E. PPS: SMA input, Schmitt buffer, quad buffer, four outputs (3.3 V CMOS, DC coupled)
ESD diodes D10 to D13 go from the signal to GND (pin 2).
Output = 3.3 V CMOS into the SDR PPS input.
TP1 VIN_5V, TP2 +3V3_OSC, TP3 +3V3_CLK, TP4 CLK10_IN,
TP5 OSC_OE, TP6 PPS_BUF, TP7 GND.
Which SDR SMA is 10 MHz and which is PPS: verify on one SDR (Q-015).
